title: THC Solo Cup Grow-Off
summary: A compact-container indoor grow-off built around consistent weekly documentation and a fixed event-format schedule.
editionNotice: These are the permanent format rules and schedule markers. A year-specific announcement determines whether an edition is currently open and supplies that edition's calendar year and final results.
rules: Use a 500 mL cup or a 16–18 oz cup as the grow container.
Post at least one qualifying plant photo each week.
Maintain a grow diary or dedicated Discord grow thread.
Do not use blurple-only lighting for required documentation photos.
Autoflowers are allowed, but the event format does not recommend them.

timeline.label: Event start
timeline.detail: The locked event format begins on 4/20.

timeline.label: Seedling window
timeline.detail: The format reserves roughly two weeks for early seedling establishment.

timeline.label: Vegetative window
timeline.detail: The standard schedule provides roughly four weeks of vegetative growth before the flip target.

timeline.label: Flip target
timeline.detail: June 1 is the locked photoperiod-flip target in the event format.

timeline.label: Flower window
timeline.detail: The standard format allows roughly ten weeks for flowering after the flip target.

timeline.label: Last-harvest target
timeline.detail: August 10 is the last-harvest marker in the locked schedule.

timeline.label: Winner announcement target
timeline.detail: The standard event format places the winner announcement on September 1.

judging: Top three placements are selected through community voting with staff review.

title: Freebie Grow-Off
summary: A low-barrier community grow-off built around actually running the free seed that has been sitting in the collection.
tagline: That freebie you forgot about might be the one.
editionNotice: This page preserves the locked participation rule. A year-specific announcement determines the active edition, calendar year, judging details, and final results.
rules: Start the qualifying grow log in Discord by December 1 for the announced edition.

timeline.label: Grow-log deadline
timeline.detail: The qualifying Discord grow log must be started by the edition's December 1 deadline.
